detail.longDescription: Tired of Microsoft pushing promotional apps and targeted offers through the Windows 11 Start menu and Settings? You can easily stop the OS from tracking your usage for ads by adjusting a few hidden privacy toggles. Learn how to reclaim your desktop experience in our latest guide: https:// geekrewind.com/how-to-opt-out- of-targeted-offers-in-windows-11-privacy-settings/ # Windows # Privacy # TechTips # Microsoft # OpenSource
